constraints: Keep every Terraform google_cloudfunctions*_function runtime on one Google Cloud Functions runtime ID that Google still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require language and dependency changes; confirm handlers run on the replacement before deploying.

steps.instructions: Change the reported runtime to a supported Google Cloud Functions runtime ID (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the Google Cloud Functions runtime

steps.instructions: Update every other Terraform google_cloudfunctions*_function runtime and deploy configuration that still pins the old runtime ID.
steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces

verification.purpose: Initialize without touching remote state and check that the configuration is valid.
Review the plan and confirm the runtime change is the intended one.

rule.summary: The Cloud Run functions runtime support schedule lists Ruby 3.2 (runtime ID ruby32) as deprecated on 2026-03-31 and decommissioned on 2026-09-30. Google no longer provides maintenance for that runtime.
rule.title: Google Cloud Functions Ruby 3.2 runtime is end-of-life
